response.original_title: British Pathé: Vivien Leigh & Laurence Olivier
response.overview: 1946 promotional newsreel on behalf of the Cinematograph Trade Benevolent Fund; at the Old Vic Theatre Company, London, Laurence Olivier makes an appeal for the fund and talks about the first royal film command performance. In the Piccadilly Theatre, Vivien Leigh speaks on behalf of the fund and about who it benefits.
response.tagline: Each of them, in different ways, has contributed to your entertainment in the past; please help them with your contribution now.
response.title: British Pathé: Vivien Leigh & Laurence Olivier
